# AIMT Design Consistency Audit — Pass 1
*Generated by Claude Code, per `docs/AIMT-Art-Direction-Brief.md`. No files were changed — this is a report only.*

**Scope:** index.html, courses.html, headspa-mastery.html, student-access.html, success.html, verify.html, terms.html, privacy.html, refunds.html, my-aimt.html, assets/css/aimt-design-system.css, assets/css/aimt-brand.css.

**Method:** systematic pattern extraction (font-family/size, hex/rgba color, border-radius, button styles, spacing, stylesheet `<link>` tags) via grep across all ten pages and both stylesheets, cross-referenced against the tokens defined in `aimt-design-system.css`. This surfaces the significant, high-confidence drift patterns — not a literal enumeration of every declaration in ~1MB of HTML.

---

## (4) Pages not loading the design system or brand fonts — the clearest bugs

| Page | `aimt-design-system.css` | `aimt-brand.css` | Google Fonts loaded |
|---|---|---|---|
| index.html | ✅ | — | Montserrat, Playfair Display, Outfit |
| courses.html | ✅ | ✅ | Montserrat, Playfair Display, Outfit |
| headspa-mastery.html | ✅ | — | Montserrat, Playfair Display, Outfit |
| student-access.html | ✅ | — | Montserrat, Playfair Display, Outfit |
| **success.html** | **❌ not loaded** | — | Montserrat, Playfair Display, Outfit |
| verify.html | ✅ | — | Playfair Display, Outfit **(no Montserrat)** |
| terms.html | ✅ | — | Playfair Display, Outfit **(no Montserrat)** |
| privacy.html | ✅ | — | Playfair Display, Outfit **(no Montserrat)** |
| refunds.html | ✅ | — | Playfair Display, Outfit **(no Montserrat)** |
| my-aimt.html | ✅ | — | Playfair Display, Outfit **(no Montserrat)** |

**Bug 1 — success.html never loads the design system.** It's the only page with zero `<link>` to `aimt-design-system.css`. Any `var(--aimt-*, fallback)` reference on that page silently falls through to its hardcoded fallback value instead of the real token — currently harmless because the fallbacks happen to match, but it's a landmine: the moment a token changes, this page won't follow.

**Bug 2 — five pages reference a font they never load.** `verify.html`, `terms.html`, `privacy.html`, `refunds.html`, and `my-aimt.html` all contain `font-family: var(--aimt-font-mont, 'Montserrat', sans-serif)` (used for small uppercase brand/label text), but none of their `<link>` tags request Montserrat — only Playfair Display and Outfit. In every browser that doesn't already have Montserrat cached from another tab, that text silently renders in the browser's default sans-serif instead. This is invisible in normal development (Montserrat is usually already cached from visiting index.html first) but real for a cold, first-time visitor landing directly on any of these five pages.

**Bug 3 — inconsistent Playfair Display request.** The Montserrat-loading group requests `Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400` (includes italic). The five Montserrat-missing pages request `Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;600` (no italic, different weight set). Two different font-loading contracts for the same typeface family, for no apparent functional reason.

**Recommendation:** every page should load the *same* single Google Fonts request — Montserrat (300;400;600;700) + Playfair Display (ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400) + Outfit (300;400;500) — and every page should load `aimt-design-system.css`. `aimt-brand.css` can stay scoped to courses.html only (confirmed no other page uses its `.aimt-*` classes, so this one is *not* a bug).

## (1) Values that deviate from design-system tokens

### Typography — the "H1" role has three unrelated implementations
No page uses `var(--aimt-type-h1)` or `var(--aimt-type-h2)` from the design system directly. Instead, every page hand-rolls its own `clamp()` and a locally-redefined `--mont`/`--serif` variable:

| Page | H1-equivalent | font-family var | font-size |
|---|---|---|---|
| index.html | `.hero-headline` | `var(--mont)` *(local, not `--aimt-font-mont`)* | `clamp(3rem, 6.5vw, 7.5rem)` |
| courses.html | `.page-title` | `var(--mont)` | `clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)` ← matches `--aimt-type-h1` value exactly, but doesn't reference it |
| headspa-mastery.html | `.lp-headline` | `var(--mont)` | `clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)` ← same as above |
| student-access.html | `.headline` | `var(--mont)` | `clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem)` |
| success.html | `.headline` | `var(--mont)` | `clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem)` |
| verify.html | `h1` | `var(--aimt-font-serif)` | `clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem)` |
| terms.html | `h1` | `var(--aimt-font-serif)` | `clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem)` |
| privacy.html | `h1` | `var(--aimt-font-serif)` | `clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem)` |
| refunds.html | `h1` | `var(--aimt-font-serif)` | `clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem)` |
| my-aimt.html | `h1` | `var(--aimt-font-serif)` | `clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.4rem)` ← off by 0.1rem from the other four |

Two real findings:
- **The five "hero-style" pages (index, courses, headspa-mastery, student-access, success) all locally redefine an identical `--mont`/`--serif`/`--sans`/`--mono` variable block**, byte-for-byte the same values as `aimt-design-system.css`'s `--aimt-font-mont`/`--aimt-font-serif`/etc. Five redundant copies of the same four values, and the h1/h2 rules point at the local copy, not the shared token — so a future rebrand only needs to touch one file for the tokens to update but would still miss these five overrides.
- **`my-aimt.html`'s h1 is a near-duplicate** of the identical rule shared by verify/terms/privacy/refunds (`clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem)` vs `clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.4rem)`) — no apparent reason for the divergence.
- Separately, whether the sans-serif-uppercase "hero" treatment (index/courses/headspa-mastery/student-access/success) and the serif "quiet utility page" treatment (verify/terms/privacy/refunds/my-aimt) *should* be two different systems is a real design decision, not a bug — flagging it here as the single biggest structural choice this audit surfaces, for your call in the normalization pass.

### Border-radius — three well-used values have no token
The design system tokens only cover four radii: `--aimt-radius-pill: 980px`, `--aimt-radius-card: 18px`, `--aimt-radius-media: 14px`, `--aimt-radius-panel: 16px`. In practice, sitewide usage also includes:
- `10px` — ~28 occurrences, no token
- `12px` — ~21 occurrences, no token
- `20px` — ~13 occurrences, no token
- `999px` — 4 occurrences, clearly meant as "pill" but diverges from the `980px` token (both round out to a full pill at typical button heights, so visually identical today, but two different numbers for the same intent)

### Section spacing — the documented "standard" is the minority pattern
`--aimt-section-pad-standard: 5rem 2rem 6rem` is used correctly twice (courses.html), but `padding: 5.5rem 1.5rem` appears 9 times across other pages/sections as the de facto standard instead — meaning the token itself may be documenting the wrong value, or those 9 sections should be converted to match it. Worth a decision either way rather than leaving both as "standard."

## (2) Near-duplicate colors

`#a3968d` (the accent token) dominates at 75 uses and is healthy. `#262626`, `#1a1814`, `#faf8f5`, and `#7a6e66` also match their tokens cleanly. The drift is in everything adjacent to those:

| Cluster (intended role) | Hex values found | Token that should win |
|---|---|---|
| Near-black warm background | `#1a1814` (14×, **token**), `#1a1a1a` (15×), `#1e1a16` (3×), `#1a1714` (3×) | `#1a1814` |
| Muted taupe / warm neutral (light) | `#cdc8bc` (12×), `#dfdacf` (5×), `#d4c4a8` (3×), `#d8c0a0` (10×), `#d4b890` (10×), `#c8b89a` (2×), `#c4bdb5` (3×) | needs one canonical light-taupe token — currently 7 near-misses |
| Muted taupe / warm neutral (dark) | `#8a7660` (14×), `#8a8078` (5×), `#4a3c28` (2×), `#4d403a` (18×) | needs one canonical dark-taupe token — currently 4 near-misses |
| Gray-black shorthand | `#333` (2×) | should be `#262626` (the actual near-black token) — `#333` is CSS shorthand for `#333333`, a different value entirely, not just a formatting shortcut |

**Not flagged as drift (intentional):** the five scalp-type category colors (`.neutral-icon #3a5a3a`, `.oily-icon #7a5a20`, `.dry-icon #5a4a70`, `.combo-icon #3a5060`, `.sensitive-icon #7a3030`, and their badge/light variants) are a deliberate 5-hue semantic system for course content, not a color that drifted — same for the danger/success reds and greens used in status pills.

## (3) Inconsistent button treatments

`.cta-primary` (index.html) and `.lp-enroll-btn` (headspa-mastery.html) are both primary enrollment CTAs and mostly agree — both use `border-radius: 980px` (correct token) — but:
- `.cta-primary` font-size `0.68rem` vs `.lp-enroll-btn` font-size `0.62rem` (which matches `--aimt-btn-font-size: 0.62rem` exactly — `.cta-primary` is the outlier).
- `.cta-primary` padding `0.86rem 1.15rem` vs `.lp-enroll-btn` padding `0.86rem 1.05rem` — same vertical, 0.1rem apart horizontal.
- `.nav-btn` (index.html) correctly matches `--aimt-btn-font-size-nav: 0.74rem` exactly — this one's clean, included for contrast.

---

## Recommended normalization (design-system token wins in every case)

1. **Fonts:** standardize the single Google Fonts `<link>` (Montserrat 300/400/600/700 + Playfair Display ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400 + Outfit 300/400/500) across all 10 pages. Add `aimt-design-system.css` to success.html.
2. **Typography variables:** replace the 5 locally-redefined `--mont`/`--serif`/`--sans`/`--mono` blocks with direct references to `--aimt-font-mont`/`--aimt-font-serif`/`--aimt-font-sans`/`--aimt-font-mono`. Requires a decision, not just a mechanical swap: keep two H1 systems (bold sans hero vs quiet serif utility) or converge — recommend **keep both**, since they serve genuinely different page types, but formalize each as its own named token pair in the design system instead of ad hoc clamp() values.
3. **my-aimt.html h1:** align to `clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.3rem)` to match verify/terms/privacy/refunds exactly.
4. **Border-radius:** either promote `10px`, `12px`, `20px` to real tokens (they're clearly an intentional graduated scale given the usage volume) or consolidate each to its nearest existing token — recommend promoting, since collapsing would visibly change card/button shapes. Fix the one real bug: change the 4 `999px` occurrences to `980px`.
5. **Section padding:** decide whether `5rem 2rem 6rem` (the documented token) or `5.5rem 1.5rem` (the majority pattern) is correct, and update either the token or the 9 outlier sections to match.
6. **Colors:** consolidate the near-black-background cluster to `#1a1814`, fix the two `#333` instances to `#262626`, and pick one canonical hex each for the light-taupe and dark-taupe clusters (recommend the highest-frequency value in each: `#8a7660` for dark-taupe, and either `#cdc8bc` or `#d8c0a0` for light-taupe — your call, both are near-tied at ~10-12 uses).
7. **Buttons:** align `.cta-primary` to `.lp-enroll-btn`'s font-size (`0.62rem`, the actual token value) and padding (`0.86rem 1.05rem`).

I have **not** changed anything. Review this and tell me which normalizations to apply — then I'll do it as its own commit per the brief's follow-up prompt.
